verdict_classification.PASS: the measurement ran and the evidence proves the requirement met
verdict_classification.FAIL: the measurement ran and the evidence proves the requirement violated
verdict_classification.BLOCKED: the required measurement did not happen: a prerequisite, tool or environment was unavailable
verdict_classification.INCONCLUSIVE: the measurement ran, but the quality or completeness of its evidence does not support a valid verdict
verdict_classification.SKIPPED: the probe does not apply on this host and claims nothing
verdict_classification.NOT_TESTED: the probe was not exercised in this run

verdict_rules: a missing binary, adapter or prerequisite before the measurement starts is BLOCKED, never FAIL
a failed positive control is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS and never FAIL for the targeted security claim
a proven leak or escape is FAIL
BLOCKED, INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_TESTED are never promoted to PASS
W1 or Linux/POSIX evidence never substitutes for a Windows measurement required by W4
where the report and the raw evidence disagree, the raw evidence is the reference and the report is defective
a final W4 PASS requires no FAIL, no BLOCKED, no INCONCLUSIVE and no security-critical NOT_TESTED

probes.title: an out-of-scope read is denied for the filesystem scope
Windows HANDLE inheritance regression (X03) with a positive control
probes.detail: A deliberately leaked inheritable handle WAS detected under ambient inheritance - by the child and by a complete parent enumeration of the handle table - and was NOT present once an explicit handle list was used, for the adapter child and for the real W4 executor.

probes.title: AppContainer + Job Object integration of the real W4 executor
probes.detail: The real W4 executor ran inside a zero-capability AppContainer, inside a kill-on-close Job, with an explicit handle list, a completely enumerated handle table and a constructed environment. The PEP refused the out-of-scope read for the correct logical reason, the OS boundary itself refused the denied fixture while a byte-identical granted fixture was readable, no child outlived the Job, and every ACL grant, profile and temporary tree was removed and verified.
